summary_text: Client 001 is a conservative investor with an AUM of Rp 8,862,806,178. The rule engine identified five anomalies. Three of them (F1, F5) are explained by recent advisor notes – a dormant account reactivation and a one‑off transfer to a family house down payment. The remaining three anomalies (F2, F3, F4) are high‑severity, involve first‑time transfers to new counterparties, and are not explained by the advisor notes. The largest outflow (Rp 5,840,716,708) to cp_big_001 (F3) represents 66% of the client’s AUM and is 737× the usual upper bound. The other two outflows (Rp 42,160,510 to cp_travel_001 and Rp 24,033,725 to cp_ins_annual) are also far above the client’s typical outflow levels.
